title: Reinstatement Shares on the Arrears of a Large-Volume Crop Input Purchasing Account
content:
A member whose season's buying has passed the programme's volume discount threshold remits a lighter share of the settlement base than the reinstatement share the programme carries, and how light follows the credit department's standing decision on the account.

**Clause.** Where the member's input spend on the account over the 10 statement months before the handling date is at or above the programme's volume discount threshold and the credit department's standing decision on the account is an approval, the share the member must remit is 40 percent. Where that spend is at or above the programme's volume discount threshold and that decision is conditional, the share is 55 percent. In every other case no substituted share applies on the Crop Input Purchasing Accounts.

| Input spend over the 10 statement months | Standing decision on the account | Share of the settlement base the member must remit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| at or above the programme's volume discount threshold | approval | 40 percent |
| at or above the programme's volume discount threshold | conditional | 55 percent |
| below that threshold | either | No substituted share |

## The threshold the spend is measured against

| Programme | Volume discount threshold (USD) |
| --- | --- |
| Cash Purchase Account | 0 |
| Standard 30-Day Charge Account | 0 |
| Seasonal Terms Crop Input Account | 75000 |
| Early Pay Prepay Program Account | 0 |
| Full Acre Input Financing Account | 150000 |
| Precision Partner Input Program Account | 250000 |

The decision read is the one standing on the account, not the member's account of what credit has told them.
